evidence: A commenter highly recommends mash-playbook for secure containerized self-hosting and highlights non-root execution, read-only operation, and capability dropping where possible.

evidence_sources.excerpt: I highly recommend https://github.com/mother-of-all-self-hosting/mash-playbook for those interested in secure containerized self hosting. A tremendous number of services are supported non-root user execution, read-only, and cap-drop where possible
